steps.said:
To determine which depot runs out of pallet space first, we compare each depot’s available free space against its net weekly intake.

- **Kirov**: Capacity 4,000 pallets. Stock on hand 3,100. Free space = 900 pallets. Intake = 300 pallets/week. Time to full = 900 ÷ 300 = 3 weeks.
- **Omsk**: Built capacity 2,500 + annex 1,200 = 3,700 pallets. Stock 1,900. Free space = 1,800 pallets. Intake = 250 pallets/week. Time to full = 1,800 ÷ 250 = 7.2 weeks.
- **Tara**: Capacity 3,000 pallets. Stock 2,000. Free space = 1,000 pallets. Intake = 260 pallets/week. Time to full = 1,000 ÷ 260 ≈ 3.85 weeks.

Kirov reaches capacity in 3 weeks, earlier than Tara (~3.85 weeks) and Omsk (7.2 weeks). Therefore Kirov runs out of pallet space first.

ANSWER: kirov
